Definition: to cramp, literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bind, be narrow, be in distress, make narrow, cause distress, besiege, be straitened, be bound; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to bind, tie up, shut up; 1a2) to be scant, be cramped, be in straits; 1b) (Pual) to be bound, be tied up; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to make narrow for, cause distress to, press hard upon; 1c2) to suffer distress; 2) to show hostility toward, vex; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to show hostility toward, treat with enmity, vex, harass; 1a2) vexer, harasser (participle)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
